prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (services, industry, budget, timeline, company size, results you care about). I can help find the best fit for you, but first I need a bit more information.

Quick checklist of what matters when picking an agency
- Primary services needed: branding, web design, SEO, paid media (PPC), social, content, email, PR, analytics, B2B demand gen, etc.
- Industry: healthcare, real estate, tech/SaaS, nonprofits, consumer products, professional services, etc.
- Company size & stage: startup, SMB, enterprise
- Monthly/annual budget and preferred engagement model (project, retainer, performance-based)
- Timeline and key goals (lead volume, revenue, brand awareness, fundraising support)
- Location preference: local (MD) vs. open to agencies elsewhere/remote
- Required proof: case studies, references, certifications, local presence

If you tell me those details I can:
- Recommend 3–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs, with strengths/weaknesses
- Summarize relevant case studies, typical pricing ranges, and contract considerations
- Give a short RFP template/questions to vet finalists

If you prefer to search yourself, good resources: Clutch.co, UpCity, Google Business reviews, LinkedIn, local industry awards (Baltimore Business Journal, Maryland Tech Council), and referrals from peers.

Tell me the services, industry, and budget and I’ll put together a tailored shortlist.
